entries.en: It's pissing me off. Can't get a signal on the road – don't even know if someone swiped right on me.
entries.ro: Mă calcă pe nervi, pula mea. N-am semnal pe drum – nici nu știu dacă m-a dat cineva swipe right.

entries.en: How 'bout someone from here, eh? I've seen Reggie checking you out – at least he's not murdery-lookin' like the others.
entries.ro: Ce zici de unu' de aici, nu? L-am văzut pe Reggie cum te pipăie cu privirea – măcar nu arată a criminal ca ceilalți.

entries.en: Ugh, I had a dog named Reggie. Then he ran away. History'll repeat itself, I can feel it...
entries.ro: Ugh, am avut un câine pe nume Reggie. Apoi a fugit. O să se repete istoria, simt eu...
